title: NoSQL Data Management
excerpt: Exam-ready notes on NoSQL data management: types, aggregates, key-value and document models, graph databases, map-reduce, and partitioning.

title: Systems Vulnerability Scanning
excerpt: Complete notes on vulnerability scanning: port identification, banner grabbing, traffic and vulnerability probes, plus hands-on coverage of Netcat, Nmap, and Wireshark.

title: Block Ciphers and the Data Encryption Standard (DES)
excerpt: Covers block cipher principles, confusion and diffusion, the Feistel structure, full DES internals (rounds, key schedule, S-boxes), the avalanche effect, differential and linear cryptanalysis, meet-in-the-middle attacks, Triple DES, and all five modes of operation (ECB, CBC, CFB, OFB, CTR).

title: Classical Encryption Techniques
excerpt: Covers the symmetric cipher model, cryptanalysis and attack types, and classical ciphers including Caesar, monoalphabetic, Playfair, Hill, Vigenere, one-time pad, transposition, and steganography, with interactive demos for each.

title: Information & Network Security: Assignment 1 & 2 Solutions
excerpt: Complete worked solutions for Information and Network Security Assignments 1 and 2, covering classical ciphers (Hill, Vigenere, Playfair, transposition, OTP) and DES internals (Feistel structure, S-boxes, CFB mode, triple DES, meet-in-the-middle attacks).
